voice_description: Role: colossal ancient female dragon capable of elegant human language, with a highly shaped epic animated creature voice. Gender: female. Age: many centuries old and immensely powerful. Persistent vocal posture: maintain enormous low chest-and-throat resonance through every word, as if speech is being produced inside a body vastly larger than a human body. Pitch: exceptionally low female contralto, intentionally beneath ordinary female conversational range. Resonance: huge cavernous chest resonance, deep throat resonance and broad mouth resonance. Timbre: smoky, dark, velvety, resonant, slightly metallic, subtly rough and immensely full. Phonation: dense controlled vocal production with slow low-frequency vibration, occasional creaky onset and subtle rumbling undertone. Breathing: slow powerful inhalations and warm resonant exhalations between major thoughts. Articulation: broad regal vowels, heavily weighted consonants and very precise diction. Prosody: majestic long downward contours, wide pauses and deliberate changes in intensity. Personality: ancient, intelligent, proud, dangerous, patient and faintly amused. Important: apparent physical scale must remain unmistakably non-human throughout ordinary speech. Do not simply produce a deep-voiced woman or dramatic audiobook narrator.
direction: Speak with immense serene authority. Begin after a slow resonant breath and allow a subtle low rumbling undertone around the opening words. Keep the delivery elegant rather than roaring; physical scale and vocal posture should make it unmistakably draconic.

text: Ahhh... so this is the little queen everyone has been whispering about. Come closer. I have watched kingdoms rise and disappear from these mountains, yet somehow your name has traveled farther than armies. I would very much like to know why.
